notes: The scenario retains direct 2025 C++ API mappings for Local Delete Object Instance (§6.18.1) and Get Object Instance Name (§10.8). It directly tests IEEE 1516.1-2025 §6.1.6 p108-l146-43 through both locally forgotten and resigning final-known federate paths; after ownership is relinquished and no joined federate knows each instance, a surviving federate can reserve the prior object name, showing the RTI deleted each orphan. This is public C++ TCK evidence, not a provider-independent conformance certification.

requirements.statement: The scenario invokes the standard Local Delete Object Instance service for a discovered object. It then probes the resulting local identity state without deleting the federation-wide object.

Section 10.8 declares ObjectInstanceNotKnown for getObjectInstanceName when the handle is not known. The test confirms the discovered handle resolves before local deletion, expects ObjectInstanceNotKnown afterward for the forgetting federate, and confirms the publisher still resolves that handle.
Consequently, orphan object instances are unreachable by any current or future federate and the RTI shall delete them.
